edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into by and between Vireo Systems Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), and the individual identified on the signature page hereto (the “Executive”).
edits.name: Parties

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer of the Company and shall perform such duties and responsibilities as are customarily associated with that position and as may reasonably be assigned by the Chief Executive Officer or the Board of Directors. The Executive shall devote substantially all business time and attention to the performance of the Executive’s duties under this Agreement.
edits.name: Position

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary in an amount to be mutually agreed by the parties and set forth in the final execution version of this Agreement (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans and programs.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, then, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company, the Executive shall be eligible to receive a severance payment in an amount to be mutually agreed by the parties and set forth in the final execution version of this Agreement (the “Severance Amount”), payable in accordance with the schedule agreed by the parties and subject to applicable withholdings.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for a period of twelve months following termination of employment for any reason, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in activities that are competitive with the Company’s business, solicit the Company’s employees or material customers, or misuse the Company’s confidential information, in each case subject to applicable law and any limitations required for enforceability in the relevant jurisdiction.
edits.name: Restrictive Covenants

receiver.message_back: Thank you—we can work from this draft, but the agreement needs to include the core executive protections: Base Salary of $425,000, target annual bonus of 60%, equity grant of 1.0% fully diluted with standard vesting, severance of 12 months’ base salary plus target bonus and COBRA continuation upon termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, with equity acceleration on a change-in-control termination. The restrictive covenants also need to be narrowed to comply with applicable law: no post-employment non-compete, employee/customer non-solicit limited to 12 months and only to persons/entities with whom the Executive had material contact, and confidentiality limited to non-public information excluding general skills and knowledge.

Counsel,

Attached is our revised draft reflecting the core executive protections you requested: specified base salary, target bonus eligibility, equity grant with standard vesting, severance upon qualifying termination, CIC-related equity acceleration, and narrowed restrictive covenants consistent with applicable law. edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $425,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall be eligible to earn an annual target bonus equal to 60% of Base Salary, subject to achievement of performance goals established by the Board of Directors or its compensation committee and the Executive’s continued employment through the applicable payment date, except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement. The Executive shall also receive an equity grant representing 1.0% of the Company’s fully diluted capitalization as of the grant date, subject to the terms of the Company’s equity incentive plan and the applicable award agreement, with standard time-based vesting over four years and a one-year cliff unless otherwise approved by the Board of Directors. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans and programs.
edits.name: Compensation revised to include salary, bonus, equity

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, then, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and continued compliance with the Executive’s surviving obligations under this Agreement, the Executive shall receive: (a) an amount equal to 12 months of Base Salary, payable in substantially equal installments in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices; (b) an amount equal to the Executive’s then-current target annual bonus, payable at the same time annual bonuses are generally paid to senior executives or as otherwise required to comply with Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code; and (c) subject to the Executive’s timely election of continuation coverage under COBRA, Company payment or reimbursement of the employer portion of COBRA premiums for up to 12 months following termination, or until the Executive becomes eligible for comparable coverage from another employer, if earlier. If such termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason occurs within 3 months before or 12 months after a Change in Control, the Executive’s then-outstanding unvested time-based equity awards shall accelerate and become vested as to 100% of the then-unvested shares subject to such awards, subject to the terms of the applicable equity plan and award agreements.
edits.name: Severance and CIC acceleration added

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall not be subject to any post-employment non-competition covenant. During employment and for 12 months following termination of employment for any reason, the Executive shall not directly or indirectly solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material contact during the final 12 months of employment, or solicit for competing business any customer or prospective customer of the Company with whom the Executive had material contact during the final 12 months of employment, in each case only to the extent permitted by applicable law. The Executive shall not at any time use or disclose the Company’s confidential information except in the proper performance of the Executive’s duties or as otherwise permitted by law. For purposes of this Agreement, confidential information means non-public information concerning the Company’s business, technology, finances, customers, partners, employees, strategies, or operations, and excludes information that is generally known to the public through no breach by the Executive and the Executive’s general skills, knowledge, and experience.
edits.name: Restrictive covenants narrowed
